name: Corporate Action Frequency Type 5 Code
definition: Automatic Reinvestment of Cash distributed by accumulating funds.

FINL.name: Final
FINL.definition: Payment of a dividend, less amounts already paid through interim dividends.

INTE.name: Interim
INTE.definition: Dividend declared and paid before annual earnings have been determined.

REGR.name: Regular
REGR.definition: Dividend paid at regular interval, for example, quarterly.

SPEC.name: Special
SPEC.definition: Dividend in addition to the regular dividend being paid by the company.
